body: Worker lesson from Sol-a7bb's R14 run test-8ea65bb0 (2026-11-11): setting TERMAL_TEST_RUN_ROOT equal to TERMAL_TEST_USER_TEMP causes every fixture allocator to panic at src/test_temp_paths.rs:71. The existing contract requires RUN_ROOT to be a direct run-* child of USER_TEMP/termal/tests. For direct Cargo after the registered launcher's -- (no test-temp-root wrapper), set repo-local TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR/TERMAL_TEST_USER_TEMP outside the input worktree and leave TERMAL_TEST_RUN_ROOT unset; the Rust owner then creates its product directory safely. Read the current resolver before inventing any override. Original compile succeeded with34warnings but all29 fixture-using cases failed before behavior,12 other cases passed; original FAIL remains preserved. Also inventory actual Rust module mounts before choosing filters: engram_naming_source.rs is source_root_naming::source_id under tests::engram_host_adapter::turn_observations, not tests::engram_naming_source. Check actual executed names/counts, not filename-derived assumptions.
